"CREATE A HIGH-QUALITY REALISTIC 3D OPEN WORLD OFFROAD ADVENTURE GAME FOR ANDROID.

GAME TITLE: OFFROAD ADVENTURE 4X4

IMPORTANT:
Create an actual playable 3D mobile game inside the game engine. Do not create a website, browser game, HTML project, or static image. Use the native game creation capabilities and 3D features supported by this AI Game Maker.

GAME CONCEPT:
Create a realistic offroad driving simulator where players can freely explore a massive open world using 4x4 vehicles. The environment must be beautiful, detailed, immersive, and full of challenging offroad terrain.

1. OPEN WORLD ENVIRONMENT

Create a huge explorable 3D world containing:

- Dense tropical forests.
- Tall mountains and rocky hills.
- Muddy roads and deep mud.
- Rivers and water crossings.
- Beautiful lakes.
- Waterfalls.
- Deserts and dry terrain.
- Snowy mountains.
- Small villages.
- Camping locations.
- Abandoned roads.
- Deep valleys.
- Hidden exploration areas.

Make the world seamless and allow players to drive freely without loading screens whenever possible.

2. REALISTIC VEHICLES

Add multiple vehicles:

- 4x4 Jeep Wrangler.
- Toyota Land Cruiser style SUV.
- Offroad pickup truck.
- Monster truck.
- Rally SUV.
- Heavy offroad truck.
- Modified adventure jeep.

Each vehicle must have realistic:

- Engine sounds.
- Acceleration.
- Braking.
- Steering.
- Suspension.
- Wheel movement.
- Tire traction.
- Vehicle weight.
- Damage system.

3. REALISTIC OFFROAD PHYSICS

This is one of the most important features.

Implement:

- Realistic suspension movement.
- Wheels adapting to uneven terrain.
- Mud and dirt effects.
- Tire grip changes depending on terrain.
- Water resistance when crossing rivers.
- Vehicle body movement on rocky roads.
- Vehicle slipping on steep slopes.
- Realistic acceleration and braking.

Vehicles must feel heavy and believable.

4. MOBILE CONTROLS

Create a comfortable touchscreen control system:

- Steering wheel or left and right steering buttons.
- Gas pedal.
- Brake pedal.
- Reverse gear.
- Handbrake.
- Camera rotation.
- Camera perspective switching.
- Vehicle reset button.
- Headlights.
- Horn.
- Gear selector.

All controls must work properly on Android touchscreen devices.

5. CAMERA SYSTEM

Include:

- Third-person camera behind the vehicle.
- First-person cockpit camera.
- Front camera.
- Free camera.
- Smooth camera movement.
- Camera rotation using touchscreen.

6. WEATHER AND DAY/NIGHT

Create a dynamic environment with:

- Realistic sunrise and sunset.
- Day and night cycle.
- Heavy rain.
- Fog.
- Thunderstorms.
- Wet road surfaces.
- Muddy terrain after rain.
- Realistic vehicle headlights at night.

7. MISSIONS AND ACTIVITIES

Add many activities:

- Mountain exploration.
- Rescue missions.
- Delivering supplies.
- Driving through dangerous terrain.
- River crossing challenges.
- Mountain climbing challenges.
- Offroad racing.
- Vehicle recovery missions.
- Time trials.
- Discovering hidden locations.

Reward players with virtual money and experience points.

8. VEHICLE GARAGE AND CUSTOMIZATION

Create a detailed garage where players can:

- Buy new vehicles.
- Change vehicle colors.
- Upgrade engines.
- Upgrade suspension.
- Change tires.
- Install offroad bumpers.
- Add roof racks.
- Install additional lights.
- Customize wheels.
- Upgrade vehicle performance.

9. REALISTIC GRAPHICS

Use high-quality realistic 3D graphics:

- Detailed vehicle models.
- Realistic terrain textures.
- Beautiful forest environments.
- Realistic water.
- Dynamic shadows.
- High-quality lighting.
- Realistic vegetation.
- Tire tracks.
- Mud splashes.
- Dust particles.
- Realistic engine and environmental sounds.

10. HUD AND INTERFACE

Display:

- Speedometer in KM/H.
- RPM meter.
- Gear indicator.
- Fuel level.
- Vehicle damage.
- Compass.
- Minimap.
- Mission objectives.
- Virtual money.
- Pause menu.

Use a professional modern offroad simulator interface.

11. ANDROID OPTIMIZATION

Optimize the entire game for Android phones.

- Stable performance.
- Adjustable graphics quality.
- Low, Medium, High and Ultra graphics settings.
- Optimize 3D models and textures.
- Efficient rendering.
- Responsive touchscreen controls.
- Landscape orientation.
- Avoid excessive memory usage.
- Smooth camera movement.

12. SAVE SYSTEM

Save player progress, owned vehicles, money, upgrades, discovered locations, and completed missions.

13. FINAL REQUIREMENTS

The game must be genuinely playable.

Do not make only a visual demonstration or a static 3D environment.

The player must be able to drive vehicles, explore the world, cross rivers, climb mountains, complete missions, customize vehicles, and interact with the environment.

Prioritize a fully functional driving system and a beautiful explorable open world.

If the complete game is too large to generate at once, build it in stages while preserving all previously implemented features.

Start by creating the first fully playable version with one realistic 4x4 jeep, a large forest and mountain environment, working mobile controls, realistic driving physics, and a third-person camera.
"
